body: Phantasy Star Portable is Sonic Team and Alfa System's PSP action role-playing game, first released in Japan on 31 July 2008. Set after Phantasy Star Universe and its expansion, it follows a created character partnered with Vivienne, a newly built CAST android. Their investigation reveals that the threat of the SEED has not entirely disappeared. The story gives the repeated missions a personal companion, while character creation lets the player determine who enters them. Science-fiction weapons, fantasy enemies and developing equipment connect the portable adventure to the broader Phantasy Star setting.

The player begins by choosing a race and class, then adjusts features ranging from facial appearance to clothing, body proportions and voice. Those choices establish an adventurer whose capabilities continue to develop through combat and equipment. Missions provide repeated opportunities to use the character's current tools and acquire something more useful for the next expedition. The appeal lies partly in that continuity: a short assignment can still contribute to a longer career. Returning to familiar action becomes worthwhile because the character and the available equipment are no longer quite the same as before.

A single-player story sits alongside cooperative multiplayer for up to four people, allowing the portable format to support shared expeditions. Tatsuya Nagata directed the game, with music including work by Hideaki Kobayashi, Taihei Sato and Kenichi Tokoi. International releases followed in 2009, before the sequel advanced the setting by three years. Phantasy Star Portable's contribution was to make the series' cycle of missions, equipment and personal character growth available on PSP, with the possibility of carrying that developed adventurer into a session played alongside other people.
